chunks: My father - may God be pleased with him - narrated to us, saying: Sa'd ibn Abdullah narrated to us, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn ibn Abi al-Khattab, from al-Hijjal [from Safwan ibn Yahya], from Safwan ibn Mihran al-Jamal, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
Whoever performs the Hajj pilgrimage three times, poverty will never afflict him.
ai.seo_question: What is the benefit of performing Hajj three times according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In *Al-Khisal*, Shaykh al-Saduq records this concise tradition from Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) linking the spiritual discipline of repeated Hajj to divine provision (*rizq*), reflecting the Shia belief in the tangible worldly benefits of consistent worship. This narration is often interpreted not merely as a guarantee of wealth, but as protection from the spiritual and material destitution that distracts from devotion, emphasizing the holistic nature of Islamic prosperity.
